## 2. The four convergent statistics

The framing survives, with one correction: **"density test" and "coincidence/persistence vote" are not two statistics — they are one** (occupancy count over a 3×3 px × Δt spatiotemporal tube; spatial neighbors and temporal slices are the same support count read along different axes; the ir-astro and neuromorphic screens both reached this independently). The genuine fourth convergent statistic is the amortized patch-evidence head. Corrected roster, each row carrying our measured event-domain number:

| # | Statistic | Independent inventions | Our number |
|---|---|---|---|
| R1 | Local spatiotemporal support count | Schwartz M-of-N, radar 1956 **[V]** → Garg–Nayar binary field, RGB 2004† → Delbruck BAF, DVS 2008† → DROR, LiDAR 2018† → Windhorst coincidence vote, astronomy 1994† → our density feature | AUC **0.7265** @ τ=5 ms (0.5549 @ 104 ms). Shared failure premise: all assume isolated interferers; rain is self-correlated and 5–8× denser than signal — the cap is structural, and no field has a per-point filter for clutter denser than signal. |
| R2 | Sample-derived mean threshold (CA-CFAR family) | radar CA-CFAR → sonar split-window normalizer† → astronomy k-σ (Windhorst†, Rhoads **[V]**) → DSOR µ+s·σ **[V]** → DVS GMCM† → our self-prior τ | pixel corr **+0.9918**, event corr **0.39** — the textbook CA-CFAR breakdown in heterogeneous clutter. The one family member never transplanted to events: rank/order statistics (Rohling 1983 **[V]**). |
| R3 | Temporal band-pass bank | MTD Doppler filter bank, 1977 **[V]** (MTI canceller = its 1-band degenerate) → HOTS multi-τ surfaces† → our temporal log-Gabor bank | temporal axis pays **+0.037** as *input to spatial context*; single-pixel temporal frequency is at chance (0.50) — we inherit MTD's machinery, not its physics. |
| R4 | Amortized local-evidence head | Luo discriminative sparse coding, 2015† → PointCleanNet, 2020† → EDnCNN† / MLPF, 2023† → our 96-dim head | **+0.0523** event-BA at 0.86 ms/100K events. Every prior member targets uncorrelated noise; ours is the first aimed at a correlated, denser-than-signal interferer. |

State all four lineages in the paper before a reviewer does. Stage 5 is CFAR and we currently run its weakest variant; stages 1–4 are MTD-shaped; the density feature is a third-generation rediscovery.

Ranked by expected value. Post-shrink expectations use the mandated 3.2–5.4× haircut.

**Tier 1**

Falsifier: step-0 oracle gap on a frozen p-dump (CPU afternoon). **Kill: oracle-minus-global gap < 0.010** — which simultaneously adjudicates items 4–8 below. Step-1 kill: corr ≤ 0.50 or recovered gap < 30% or Δ < +0.005.

## 4. The chosen build

Judge consensus on execution order is unanimous even where rankings differ: **the operating-point gate runs first** (Judge 1: "lineage-table step 0 first... adjudicates the whole operating-point niche"; Judge 2: EvOS-CFAR LEAD, "run first"). The tile-variant proposal is rejected/merged as the implementation spec. ALDER is the consensus lead *paper deliverable* (Judge 1 LEAD, Judge 2 LEAD-second) and starts its CPU-only step 1 in parallel once the p-dump exists.

**Build: EvOS-CFAR falsifier ladder, tile-spec merged.**

- **Step −1 (GPU, minutes; the only GPU dependency).** Produce the per-event p-dump on the labeled scene-disjoint real EVK4 val split — one standard eval pass. Judge 2 confirmed the dump is not currently on disk. Everything downstream is numpy on CPU.
- **Step 0 (CPU, hours) — the gate.** Oracle per-event-threshold BA and oracle per-tile-τ BA vs global self-prior-τ BA. **Kill number: gap < 0.010 event-BA** ⇒ the entire operating-point niche (this, GMM, router, Carbone–Kay, Poisson-z, DTSNN) is dead in one afternoon, and the 0.39 failure is a ranking deficiency of p that no threshold family can fix.
- **Step 1 (CPU, same day).** Sweep q ∈ {0.50–0.95, step 0.05} × tile ∈ {16, 32, 64, 128, plus column strips} × guard on/off on the frozen dump. Column strips are mandatory, not optional: streaks are full-height, so clutter heterogeneity is plausibly column-shaped, and rain-majority square tiles reproduce OS-CFAR's documented interferer-saturation failure (both judges flagged this). **Kill numbers: corr ≤ 0.50 with per-scene oracle τ; recovered gap < 30%; scene-disjoint Δ < +0.005.**
- **Step 2 (build, 2–4 h, only on pass).** Per-tile 16-bin fixed-point histogram of p, ring-buffered in T=4 sub-window slabs (exact under proven roll invariance); 1 increment/event (~3 integer ops); τ_tile = q-th quantile via 16-entry cumulative scan per 26 ms sub-window (~7K adds total at 448 tiles); guard = exclude own 3×3 × 5 ms cell. GPU: fused into the head kernel (atomicAdd into 448×16 uint16 + one tiny quantile kernel). Sensor-side: ~7 KB BRAM + adder, no multiplier, no float. Cost: <2% on top of the 0.86 ms head; sub-0.1 mW incremental in 65 nm-class logic (arithmetic estimate from Rios-Navarro **[V]** energetics — label it as such).
- **Honesty constraints carried from the judges:** this asynchronizes the operating point, not the evidence — p still comes from the window-clocked trunk; τ_tile itself rebuilds on a 26 ms clock; no learned parameters (q is one global hyperparameter, and a rank over p is invariant to monotone recalibration, so no rate feature leaks in). Cite and distinguish MSF-2026† quantile masking (batch, count-domain, flow-dependent — dead here for lack of coherent rain velocity) or a reviewer will conflate them. Ceiling unchanged: 0.78 trunk BA and +0.052 head gain are evidence numbers this cannot touch.

**Second track (committed regardless of gate outcome):** ALDER step 1 — refit the logistic head with the 17 trunk dims removed and 6 leaky-band energies added, quantize to 8-bit, simulate a 1 Mb counting-hash sketch, evaluate scene-disjoint. Kill: < 0.820. Distillation (step 2, ~1 GPU-hour of teacher forwards) only if step 1 passes; drop the distillation claim if its delta < +0.003.

## 5. The low-power/async verdict

**Accuracy floor.** The full pipeline sits at ~0.832 event-BA (0.78 trunk + 0.052 head). The local-only floor is *claimed* at 0.830 but the trunk-free configuration has never actually been measured — the current 96-dim evidence embeds trunk features, so 0.820–0.831 is the honest hypothesis range pending ALDER step 1 (Judge 2's correction stands). If it holds, the headline is: **global spatial context buys < 0.01 event-BA against rain at the per-event level** — a redundancy result worth publishing on its own.

**Power.** All figures are arithmetic from cited comparables, not measured silicon — a 2–3× error is plausible and every number ships with that label. Logreg head at ~96 MACs/event, below MLPF's effective op count, ⇒ ≤4 nJ/event in the 65 nm class (Rios-Navarro **[V]**: 4 nJ/ev, 10 cycles/ev measured) ⇒ 12–34 mW at storm rates of 3–8.5 Meps; a 3K-param MLP scales to 36–170 mW. Anchors: SNNF ~1.48 mW @ 1 Meps (paper-body, unconfirmed **[V-partial]**); Speck2f < 5 mW/eye **[V]**. Two honest debits: the dominant unbudgeted term is ~7.4 Mb of per-pixel SRAM state (leakage alone is mW-scale; the hashed fallback is untested on rain's spatially-correlated counts, which are the hash's worst case), and the incumbent comparison must be an edge SoC, not a discrete GPU — at 5.5% duty cycle (5.69 ms/104 ms) the trunk averages O(100 mW) on Jetson-class hardware, so **the honest gap is 3–30×, not the 100–1000× headline** (Judge 1).

**Latency.** Compute latency sub-µs (10–20 cycles/event); informational latency is the measured **5–10 ms floor** (density AUC 0.7265 @ 5 ms collapsing to 0.5549 @ 104 ms; single-pixel timing at chance at every scale). Any microsecond-*accuracy* claim in this domain is a physically uninformed guess; the legitimate claim is ms-informed decisions at µs compute cost.

**Async coverage.** Stages 1, 2, 4, 5 map natively (bit-set accumulation, leaky integrators, patch head, streaming/OS threshold). Stage 3's global FFT does not, and the kill list closed the delta route (sparse deltas densify). Exactly two escape routes exist, neither yet validated: delete the trunk (ALDER — one CPU-day falsifier) or make the linear part local (Hough fan-out†, block 1 only; DWT locality **[V]**, ±0.011 risk).

**Verdict: a paper, conditional on one pre-registered CPU-day.** If ALDER step 1 clears 0.820, the deliverable is a Pareto point no published event-deraining system occupies (correlated, denser-than-signal interferer at tens of mW), built on the redundancy measurement rather than architecture novelty. If it fails on the hash, dense SRAM changes the silicon story and it degrades to a section. It is not a mirage either way — the 5 ms information floor makes the ms-scale async regime legitimate, and the incumbent DVS filter literature (BAF through SNNF) has never faced this interferer class.

## 6. Honest assessment

Probabilities are my estimates from the measured record, not measurements.

| Outcome | P | Basis |
|---|---|---|
| Step-0 oracle gap ≥ 0.010 | ~0.5 | 5–8× real-streak density heterogeneity argues yes; Judge 2's ranking-deficiency alternative argues no. Genuinely open. |
| OS-CFAR ships ≥ +0.005 BA (unconditional) | ~0.2–0.3 | Requires the gap AND spatial (tile/column) structure AND surviving interferer saturation. |
| ALDER step 1 clears 0.820 (8-bit + 1 Mb hash) | ~0.5–0.6 | Quantization cost was small on uncorrelated noise (MLPF **[V]**); correlated dense counts are the hash's worst case. Dense-SRAM fallback raises this to ~0.75 but weakens the silicon story. |
| Distillation delta ≥ +0.003 | ~0.15 | Bounded by an unverified 0.002–0.005 gap, then shrunk 3.2–5.4×. |
| Pseudo-labeling reaches ≥ 0.70 zero-label real BA | ~0.3 | Labels inherit the vote's 0.73 AUC; circularity with the head's own patch features is the likely failure. Still the highest-upside training-time item. |
| Any Tier-3 feature clears +0.005 (jointly) | ~0.4–0.5 | Individually ~0.1–0.35 each; column run-length is the best single bet (native-res axis historically pays +0.052). |
| Head is linearly exhausted (MLP swap ≈ logistic) | ~0.7 | Architecture span 0.011; input information dominates everywhere we have looked. |

**Goes in the current paper now, no further experiments needed:** the four-statistic equivalence table with our measured numbers per row (0.7265 cap and its structural cause; 0.9918-vs-0.39 CA-CFAR split; chance-level single-pixel timing; the correlated-denser-than-signal gap no community has addressed); the CA-CFAR diagnosis of stage 5; the distill-a-global-trunk-into-a-per-event-head result (+0.0523 at 0.86 ms/100K) — the single non-reinvention in the pipeline per all five screens, with EvDistill† and probability-flux (arXiv:2504.07503†, concurrent-at-best) as nearest neighbors to cite and distinguish; and the explicit lineage statements of Section 2 as Related Work, written before a reviewer writes them.

**Contingent on this week's two cheap experiments:** OS-CFAR as a results subsection (if the gate passes) or one honest paragraph reporting the niche dead (if it fires — a publishable negative given it kills five proposed mechanisms at once); ALDER's redundancy number either way its step 1 resolves.

**Future work, not this paper:** ALDER silicon/FPGA synthesis (every mW figure is currently arithmetic); Hough fan-out and wavelet stage-3 (both gated by offline falsifiers not yet run); pseudo-label fine-tuning at scale; a dedicated prior-art pass on rank-based thresholds for event streams (MSF-2026† and the DVS adaptive-threshold family) before any novelty claim on OS-CFAR-for-events is committed to print.

**Unverified-citation ledger:** everything marked † above was screen-cited but not full-text verified — including every RGB deraining paper except UGSM/P-MoG/FastDeRain, all LiDAR papers except DSOR/Khodamoradi/LiSnowNet, Demené, Carbone–Kay, Ye, Nitzberg, GMAP, all IR/astronomy papers except van Dokkum/Rhoads/deepCR, and the DVS family (BAF, KNoise, DWF, GMCM, HOTS, EDnCNN, DTSNN, BF2, Vitale, AEGNN, EvGNN, ESDNet, LED, EBSnoR, W-T-space, MSF, EvDistill, arXiv:2504.07503). Fifteen spot-checks across five screens found zero fabrications; two metadata corrections are mandatory in any manuscript: UGSM = Appl. Math. Model. 59:662–679 (2018), Khodamoradi & Kastner = IEEE TETC 9(1):15–23 (2021, early access 2017). SNNF's 1.48 mW figure is paper-body, unconfirmed from the abstract — cite it hedged.
